court: In the High Court of Madras†
case_number: W.P.(MD) No. 12865 of 2015 and M.P.(MD) No. 1 of 2015
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. Ajay Justice Shaw for Mr. T. Lajapathi Roy
For Respondents: Mr. B. Bhagavathi Government Advocate
prayer: Prayer: Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus, to direct the respondent Nos. 1 to 5 to drain the water from the Marudhu Tank in Melur Taluk, Madurai District to enable fishing in the tank by the petitioner within the time stipulated by this Court.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.S. Sundar, J.:— Today when the Writ Petition is taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that this Writ Petition has become infructous and that this Writ Petition can be dismissed as infructuous. The learned counsel for the petitioner has also made an endorsement to that effect. Recording the same, this Writ Petition is dismissed as infructuous. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
